tasks.prompt:
Extract the invoice number, the invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the total amount from the text below. Answer with JSON only, with the keys number, date and total.

Text: Invoice INV-2041, issued on 14 March 2026 to Lumen Bikes. Subtotal 1,250.00 EUR, VAT 20% 250.00 EUR, total due 1,500.00 EUR.

Classify the support ticket into exactly one of these categories: billing, delivery, account, product, other. Answer with the category word only.

Ticket: I was charged twice for the same order last week and I can only see one parcel.
A net price is 1,234.56 EUR and VAT is 17%. What is the VAT amount, rounded to the cent? Answer with the number only.
Translate into French, keeping a polite business tone: "We are sorry for the delay. Your refund was sent today and should reach your account within five working days."

check.rubric: Meaning complete (apology, refund sent today, five working days); polite register (vous); no added content.

tasks.prompt:
Summarize this ticket in at most 25 words for an agent who has not read it.

Ticket: Hello, I ordered a size M jacket on 2 March and received a size L. I sent it back on 9 March with the prepaid label, tracking number RT55821. The return shows as delivered on 12 March but I have had no refund and no reply to my two emails. Please help.

check.rubric: Mentions wrong size received, return delivered 12 March, no refund yet.
